user.title: Connect to your Disklavier
user.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of your Yamaha Disklavier ENSPIRE.

data_description.host: The address of the piano on your network. You can find it on the piano under Settings, Network.

reconfigure.title: Change your Disklavier's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new hostname or IP address. It must be the same piano this entry was created for.

discovery_confirm.title: Add your Disklavier
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Disklavier {model} at {host} to Home Assistant?

error.invalid_response: The device answered, but it does not look like a Disklavier ENSPIRE.

abort.wrong_piano: That address is a different Disklavier. Add it as a new device instead of reconfiguring this one.

browse_failed.message: Could not browse the Disklavier's library: {error}

unsupported_media_id.message: Cannot play "{media_id}". Choose an item from the media browser, or use a supported media content ID.

quick_link_not_found.message: No "{folder}" folder found in PC Sharing Folder. Sync it to the share and reindex, then try again.

headphone_not_selectable.message: Headphone mode is set by the piano for as long as headphones are plugged in. It cannot be chosen from here; unplug them to return to acoustic or quiet.

radio_active.message: DisklavierRadio is playing, and the piano ignores this command while it is. Stop the radio first.

radio_list_would_interrupt.message: The radio channels have not been read from the piano yet, and reading them stops whatever is playing. Stop playback and open Radio again; after that the list is kept.

hold_needs_a_song.message: Only a song that is starting or playing can be held.

hold_playback.name: Hold playback
hold_playback.description: Holds the song that is starting or playing until something else is ready for it, such as a receiver that is still waking up, then plays it from the start. Meanwhile the piano shows as buffering. Play releases the hold at once; pause, stop or another song cancel it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The longest the song waits. It plays from the start when this runs out, unless play is pressed sooner.

message.name: Message
message.description: Shown under the song title while it waits, for example "Waiting for the receiver".
